subject: Re: Aurora junket — talent hold confirmation needed
body:
Hey team,

We're holding Mike R. and Priya S. for the junket on Wednesday May 6 — 8 AM call, wrapped by 6 PM. Need confirmation by EOD Thursday or we'll release the holds. Glam can land at 6:30 if that works on your side.

Also — can someone send the run-of-show by Monday so the publicist can prep talking points?

Thanks,
Cara

subject: Mendocino oceanfront — final price + permit window
body:
Alex,

The Mendocino oceanfront house is $4,200/day, 2-day minimum. Permit window closes Friday 5/1 at noon — after that we'd have to push the shoot two weeks. Need PO by Thursday to lock it.

Sent the COI requirements separately. Crew cap 25.

— J
@here heads up — DP is asking if we can swap the Arri to a Sony Venice for Tuesday. Rental delta is +$1,800/day. Need a call before 4 PM today so the rental house can switch the kit out tonight.

subject: FYI — Aurora wardrobe check-in tomorrow 10 AM
body:
Just a confirmation note that the wardrobe check-in is tomorrow at 10 AM at our Brannan St space. No action needed unless someone needs to reschedule.

— Margot

subject: Budget overage on Aurora — need sign-off
body:
We're $12k over on Aurora, mostly post — extra VFX pass plus a sound re-record. Need the EP's sign-off this week or we cut the VFX scope. Can you and I sync tomorrow afternoon?

S.
